claude/ triage branches on origin: 161 as of this run (161 last run, unchanged), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.
Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences, most recently cycle 1403), ESTAT (cycles 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371, 1395, 1407), ECB (cycles 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). No new occurrence this run (cycles 1409-1411 clean). Still unfixed; recommend addressing the exception handler.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict stays ok (flipped again this run on ILO).
